title.pinyin: Tí tài duō, wǒ méi zuò wán
title.english: There were too many questions; I didn't finish all of them

instruction.hanzi: 给下面的词语选择对应的图片
instruction.english: Match the pictures with the words/phrases.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Qǐngwèn Zhāng Huān zài ma?
dialogue.english: Hello! May I speak to Zhang Huan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 你打错了,我们这儿没有叫张欢的。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ cuò le, wǒmen zhèr méiyǒu jiào Zhāng Huān de.
dialogue.english: You've got the wrong number. There isn't anyone named Zhang Huan here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 您从几岁开始学习跳舞?
dialogue.pinyin: Nín cóng jǐ suì kāishǐ xuéxí tiào wǔ?
dialogue.english: At what age did you start to learn dancing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我第一次跳舞是在七岁的时候。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ dì yī cì tiào wǔ shì zài qī suì de shíhou.
dialogue.english: I was seven when I danced for the first time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我女儿今年也七岁了。我希望她能跟您学跳舞,可以吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér jīnnián yě qī suì le. Wǒ xīwàng tā néng gēn nín xué tiào wǔ, kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.english: My daughter is seven now. I hope she can learn to dance from you. May she?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你知道吗?大卫找到工作了。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Dàwèi zhǎodào gōngzuò le.
dialogue.english: You know what? David has got a job.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 太好了!他从什么时候开始上班?
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Tā cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàng bān?
dialogue.english: That's great! When will he start to work?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Cóng xià ge xīngqī yī kāishǐ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 这是他的第一个工作,希望他能喜欢。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì tā de dì yī ge gōngzuò, xīwàng tā néng xǐhuan.
dialogue.english: This is his first job. I hope he'll like it.

newWords.english: to work, to do a job

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 昨天的考试怎么样?你都听懂了吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Zuótiān de kǎoshì zěnmeyàng? Nǐ dōu tīngdǒng le ma?
dialogue.english: How was the test yesterday? Did you understand everything you heard?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.english: Did you finish the test paper?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Tí tài duō, wǒ méi zuòwán.
dialogue.english: There were too many questions — I didn't finish all of them.

explanation.hanzi: 一些动词或形容词可以放在动词后边,补充、说明动作的结果,它们叫作结果补语。否定式在补语前加"没(有)",句尾不能用"了"。表示疑问时,常在句尾加上"(了)没有"。
explanation.english: Certain verbs or adjectives can follow a verb to describe the result of an action — these are complements of result. The negative form puts 没(有) before the verb, and 了 cannot appear at the end. To form a question, add (了)没有 at the end.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi kànjiàn nǐ de nǚpéngyou.
Wǒ méi tīngdǒng tā shuō de huà.
examples.english: I didn't understand what he said.

explanation.hanzi: 介词"从"引出一段时间、一段路程、一件事情的经过或者一个序列的起点,后面常跟"到"一起搭配使用。
explanation.english: "从" introduces the starting point of a period of time, a distance, a process, or a sequence. It's often paired with "到".

explanation.hanzi: "第"常被放在数量短语前边,表示顺序。
explanation.english: "第" goes before a numeral-measure-word phrase to indicate order.
